description: For one country, which futures or forex prop firms' own restricted-country lists name it and which do not, with the date we read each list and its source. Or, with "firm", what one firm's list says about that country. A firm not naming a country is not a promise it will accept a trader there.

country.description: A two-letter code ("GB") or a country name.

firm.description: One firm's name. Leave empty for every firm in the market.

name: check_country_access
title: Which prop firms take traders from a country
